# infisical_group_user (Resource)

Add a user as a member of a group. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_group" "example" {
  name = "example-group"
  slug = "example-group"
  role = "member"
}

resource "infisical_group_user" "example" {
  group_id = infisical_group.example.id
  username = "<user-email>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group.
- `username` (String) The username of the user to add to the group. This is usually the user's email address, and it is case-sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the resource by its group ID and username
terraform import infisical_group_user.example <group_id>,<username>
```
